decision_table.name: Determine_VA_Filing_Requirement

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Virginia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Virginia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in VA (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Virginia filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: VA Form 500 Instructions (Corporation Income Tax Return) Reference: VA Code § 58.1-400 et seq. (Corporate Income Tax) Reference: VA Department of Taxation Publication 1630 (Nexus Guidelines)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Virginia filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: VA Code § 58.1-612 (Economic Nexus for Sales Tax - applies to income tax by analogy) Reference: VA Department of Taxation Economic Nexus Guidance
No Virginia nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_VA_Income_Adjustments

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Virginia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

decision_table.description: Calculate Virginia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Virginia state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (VA Code § 58.1-402.A) - IRC Section 199A deduction addback (VA Code § 58.1-402.A.3) - State income taxes deducted on federal return
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Virginia state and municipal obligations (VA Code § 58.1-402.B) - Dividends from affiliated corporations (85% deduction, VA Code § 58.1-402.B.3)
Reference: VA Form 500 Schedule ADJ (Additions and Subtractions) Reference: VA Code § 58.1-402 (Modifications to Federal Taxable Income) Reference: VA Department of Taxation Publication 1630
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_VA_State_Tax

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Virginia state corporate income tax. Applies 6% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

decision_table.description: Calculate Virginia state corporate income tax. Applies 6% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Virginia state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to VA: × [Apportionment % using single-sales factor] 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule ADJ] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule ADJ] 5. VA taxable income: = [Result] 6. VA tax rate: × 6.0% 7. VA income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. VA credits: - [Credits from Schedule CR] 9. VA tax liability: = [Final tax]
Virginia uses 100% single-sales factor apportionment (most favorable for manufacturers). Tax rate is a flat 6% with no brackets or alternative minimum tax.
Available VA credits include: - Research and Development Expenses Tax Credit - Green Jobs Creation Tax Credit - Major Business Facility Job Tax Credit - Neighborhood Assistance Tax Credit - Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credit - Land Preservation Tax Credit
Reference: VA Form 500 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: VA Form 500 Schedule CR (Tax Credits) Reference: VA Code § 58.1-400 (6% tax rate) Reference: VA Code § 58.1-406 through 58.1-439 (Apportionment - single-sales factor) Reference: VA Department of Taxation Publication 1630 (Corporate Income Tax)
No Virginia nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Virginia taxable income - no tax liability. Virginia allows NOL carryforward for 15 years (VA Code § 58.1-402.B.4).
